messages:
josh_docs: Heads-up, a customer reported that the dashboard embed in the Console quickstart 404s when loaded in our app due to a new CSP header from the CDN. Repro steps attached. elaine_pm: Ugh. Is this the same embed snippet we've been shipping in `docs/console/examples/embed-dashboard.html`? josh_docs: Yes. The snippet uses an iframe with `src="https://console.redwood.ai/embed/dashboard?sample=trace"` and no `referrerpolicy` or `sandbox` attributes. The CDN started sending `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'` which blocks our iframe when the customer's site is on a different host. simon_runtime: Two quick options: 1) update docs to call out CSP requirements and provide a JS fallback that fetches the dashboard snapshot server-side, 2) recommend using the embeddable widget which uses postMessage and proper allowlists. I can whip up a widget snippet. ashley_web: Also noticed the embed example sets `trace_id: 1234-abc` in the YAML which is not valid (should be 32 hex). That's likely why some previews were 404ing in our preview infra. josh_docs: Good catch. I'll update sample YAML. Proposed migration text for the page: "If you host the Console dashboard on a different domain, update your CSP to allow frame-ancestors or use our embeddable JS widget. See sample Nginx config below." + small Nginx snippet. elaine_pm: Include an explicit callout about security: prefer widget + signed snapshot tokens for third-party embeds. Also add a short note on cost: embedding live dashboards increases read rates and can affect token/cost accounting. simon_runtime: Agreed on tokenized snapshots. Here's a minimal widget snippet I'll add to the PR: ```html
``` ashley_web: For the docs change, also update `docs/console/cost-breakdown.md` sample that shows p50 vs p95 graphs. The current copy says "p95 is typical" which misleads readers; change to "p95 is a better measure for tail latency in production" and add a small code snippet showing how to compute p95 from histogram metrics. josh_docs: I'll draft two PRs: one for embed/CSP + YAML sample fixes, and one for cost wording + p95 snippet. Will include preview links. qa-bot: Automated linkcheck found: `docs/console/examples/embed-dashboard.html` -> 404 in preview build 3567. Created issue #789 in docs repo. elaine_pm: Can we also add a tiny smoke test in our doc CI that loads the embed URL and checks response code and CSP header? If it fails, the preview build should warn. simon_runtime: I can add a Puppeteer smoke test that runs in the docs CI job. Will send a PR for that test. ashley_web: One more note: update the Console sample that shows cost attribution. We had an outdated call to `client.get_costs(range='30d')` which now requires `granularity='daily'`. Put both calls in the snippet with a deprecation comment. josh_docs: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4178 (embed + YAML fix) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4180 (cost wording + p95 snippet). Please review when you have a minute. elaine_pm: Reviewed #4178, left a nit on wording and asked for an example Nginx `add_header Content-Security-Policy \"frame-ancestors 'self' https://your-site.example\";`. simon_runtime: Opened PR for Puppeteer smoke test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4182. It asserts 200 and that CSP includes `frame-ancestors`. qa-bot: CI for PR #4178 preview passed and deployed at https://deploy-preview-4178--docs.redwood.ai. Linkcheck still flags one internal anchor, pushing patch. josh_docs: Thanks all. Once #4178 and #4180 merge I'll run a quick sweep for other examples referencing the old trace_id format and the legacy cost API. Plan to ship copy changes today. :white_check_mark:
